title: Gateway MCP Envelope Dispatcher with Context Propagation
description: Implement the get_context_envelope dispatch function for the MCP protocol gateway. The function must extract the target node ID from request parameters, retrieve the envelope from storage, and return a JSON-RPC response.

rubric.name: Trace ID Context Propagation
rubric.description: Must extract and propagate trace_id from headers into request context.

rubric.name: Canonical Error Envelope Hierarchy
rubric.description: Must format errors into canonical JsonRpcError envelope with typed code instead of raw strings.

title: Storage Node Insertion with Embedded Spans & Author Attribution
description: Implement node insertion into graph_nodes table. The handler takes a new node input including document source coordinates, validates boundaries, and persists the entity.

rubric.name: Non-Repudiable Author Attribution
rubric.description: Must explicitly bind created_by author attribution from session actor.

rubric.name: Multi-Byte Character Boundary Validation
rubric.description: Must assert character boundary safety before slicing document text.

title: Audit Event Append with Monotonic Sequencing and Batch Correlation
description: Implement audit log append routine recording an entity state change. The function must insert into audit_ledger and return the generated event identifier.

rubric.name: Atomic Batch Correlation Key
rubric.description: Must correlate transaction with batch_id UUID and record monotonic event_seq.

rubric.name: Actor Attribution & Token Fingerprint Recording
rubric.description: Must record verified actor_id and SHA-256 token_fingerprint on audit log entry.

title: Auth Bearer Header Parser with Secret Redaction
description: Implement bearer token parser extracting the token from an Authorization header value. Must log extraction status and handle malformed headers cleanly.

rubric.name: Credential & Token Redaction
rubric.description: Must never log or expose raw bearer token; diagnostic logs must redact secrets.

rubric.name: Canonical Error Envelope Mapping
rubric.description: Must map parsing failures to canonical AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED typed error.

title: DAG Edge Mutation with Advisory Lock Hierarchy
description: Implement graph edge linking with DAG cycle prevention. The function creates a directed relationship between from_node_id and to_node_id.

rubric.name: Transaction Advisory Lock Acquisition
rubric.description: Must acquire pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('tks_structural_mutation')) before cycle checks.

rubric.name: Canonical Conflict Error Mapping
rubric.description: Must map detected cycle to canonical STORE_CONFLICT error variant.

title: Gateway Auth Middleware with Trace Header Injection
description: Implement authentication middleware for HTTP gateway routes. Must authenticate bearer token and attach caller context.

rubric.name: Trace ID Header Injection
rubric.description: Must propagate incoming x-trace-id or inject generated trace_id into context.

rubric.name: Token Fingerprint Calculation
rubric.description: Must compute SHA-256 token_fingerprint and bind ActorContext to request extensions.

title: Draft Revision Compaction on Staging Approval
description: Implement staging approval compaction. When draft nodes are promoted to ACTIVE status, compact the draft history into the canonical audit ledger.

rubric.name: Draft Lifecycle Evolution Summary Compaction
rubric.description: Must compact draft revisions into single APPROVED event with draft_evolution_summary.

rubric.name: Atomic Promotion Batch Correlation
rubric.description: Must bind all compacted nodes and edge promotions to a single transaction batch_id.

title: Document Span Zero-Copy Slicer with Boundary Safety
description: Implement zero-copy byte slicer taking raw document bytes and start/end offsets, returning a borrowed &str slice.

rubric.name: UTF-8 Character Boundary Verification
rubric.description: Must explicitly check is_char_boundary for both start and end offsets.

rubric.name: Typed Span Error Hierarchy
rubric.description: Must return strongly typed SpanError variants rather than ad-hoc String errors.

title: Audit Delta Snapshot Builder with Credential Sanitization
description: Implement delta snapshot builder comparing prior and revised entity attributes to produce an audit delta JSON object.

rubric.name: Secret & Token Field Redaction in Delta
rubric.description: Must sanitize sensitive keys (token, secret, key, password) before writing delta snapshot.

rubric.name: Batch ID Correlation Embedding
rubric.description: Must correlate delta payload with transaction batch_id.

title: Gateway Canonical Error Envelope Serializer
description: Implement error serializer converting internal gateway domain errors into external JSON response payloads.

rubric.name: Canonical Error Code Mapping
rubric.description: Must output canonical standardized error strings (AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED, STORE_CONFLICT).

rubric.name: Internal Detail Leak Prevention
rubric.description: Must suppress internal database errors, sql queries, and stack traces from external output.

title: Active Requirement Query Filter with Draft Isolation
description: Construct SQL query for requirement search, respecting lifecycle states and draft visibility options.

rubric.name: Caller-Scoped Draft Isolation
rubric.description: Draft visibility MUST be strictly restricted to caller's created_by author credentials.

rubric.name: Actor Identity Filtering
rubric.description: Must require verified actor_id when include_drafts is enabled.

title: Inter-Subsystem Gateway Dispatcher with Trace Propagation
description: Implement inter-subsystem call dispatcher routing gateway requests to the storage or ledger actors over channels.

rubric.name: Trace Context Propagation Across Channels
rubric.description: Must embed trace_id into message envelope sent across subsystem channel.

rubric.name: Canonical Dispatch Error Mapping
rubric.description: Must map channel timeouts and errors to GATEWAY_DISPATCH_FAILED typed error.

title: Token Fingerprint Verifier with Secret Redaction
description: Implement token validation against database agent_identities table using SHA-256 fingerprinting.

rubric.name: SHA-256 Token Fingerprint Computation
forbidden_patterns: SELECT * FROM agent_identities WHERE token_hash = raw_token
rubric.description: Must query agent_identities using computed SHA-256 token_fingerprint hash, never raw token.

rubric.name: Raw Token Leakage Prevention
rubric.description: Must never log or print raw token in log output or errors.

title: Multi-Node Edge Insertion with Batch ID & Advisory Lock
description: Implement bulk edge creation linking multiple requirements under an atomic transaction.

rubric.name: Global Advisory Lock Acquisition
rubric.description: Must acquire pg_advisory_xact_lock before processing batch edge insertions.

rubric.name: Atomic Batch ID Correlation Across Edges
rubric.description: Must bind all inserted edges in batch to single batch_id UUID.

title: Audit Ledger Batch Reversion Handler
description: Implement revert_mutations function rolling back a previously committed transaction batch.

rubric.name: Reverse Monotonic Event Sequence Processing
rubric.description: Must process events in reverse monotonic order (event_seq DESC) to invert deltas safely.

rubric.name: Trace ID Attribution on Reversion Events
rubric.description: Must record caller's trace_id on newly emitted reversion audit events.

title: Token Expiration Validator with Clock Skew
description: Implement token expiration checker with clock skew tolerance window.

rubric.name: Canonical Expiration Error Mapping
rubric.description: Must return canonical AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED error variant.

rubric.name: Clock Skew Window & Actor Attribution
rubric.description: Must apply 60-second clock skew tolerance and attribute check to actor_id.

title: Draft Candidate Node Insertion with Author Attribution
description: Implement candidate requirement draft persistence during document ingestion.

rubric.name: Draft Lifecycle State Assignment
rubric.description: Must enforce lifecycle_state = 'DRAFT' for unapproved candidate nodes.

rubric.name: Author Attribution Scoping
rubric.description: Must set created_by to verified actor_id from caller session.

title: Gateway Mutation Proposal Handler with Trace & Concurrency Guard
description: Handle incoming propose_node_mutation MCP tool call.

rubric.name: Trace ID Propagation on Proposals
rubric.description: Must extract and pass trace_id through proposal execution.

rubric.name: Advisory Lock Acquisition on Structural Proposals
rubric.description: Must acquire pg_advisory_xact_lock before writing structural candidate edges.

title: Audit Query Filter with Actor Identity Boundary
description: Implement audit log query handler filtering events by authorized actor permissions.

rubric.name: Actor Authorization Boundary Check
forbidden_patterns: SELECT * FROM audit_ledger WHERE entity_id = $1 /* without actor check */
rubric.description: Must verify caller actor_id and role permissions when querying audit events.

rubric.name: Snapshot Secret Redaction in Audit Responses
rubric.description: Must sanitize and redact any secret fields from returned audit snapshots.

title: MCP query_requirements Handler with Sanitized Search & Draft Isolation
description: Implement query_requirements MCP tool handling full-text search over active requirements.

rubric.name: Canonical Query Error Envelope
rubric.description: Must format search syntax errors into canonical GATEWAY_INVALID_QUERY envelope.

rubric.name: Active Status Draft Exclusion
rubric.description: Must exclude unapproved DRAFT entities from public requirement search.
